user.title: Pick your TV
user.description: These devices on your network have the YouTube TV app. Pick the one to tune.

manual.title: TV address
manual.description: Enter the TV's IP address (or its DIAL app URL). The YouTube TV app must be installed on it.

lineup.title: Import your YouTube TV channels
lineup.description: Open {live_url} in a desktop browser, run the lineup snippet from the README in the browser console, and paste the result here. You can also paste lines like `{example}`.

locals.title: Local stations
locals.description: Found {count} channels. Which of them carry your local ABC, CBS, NBC and FOX? (Guessed where possible.)

error.no_youtube_tv: No YouTube TV app found at that address. Is the TV on and the app installed?
error.bad_lineup: Couldn't find any channels in that text.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

data.favorites: Favorite teams (comma separated, e.g. Guardians, Cavaliers)
data.power_entity: Turn this media player on before tuning (optional)
data.local_teams: Local teams (your CBS/FOX stations always carry them)
data.top_events: Also show the day's big games from other leagues

data_description.alert_scope: Alerts fire once per game when it gets close late, goes to overtime, or a ranked team is upset-threatened. They always fire the youtube_tv_gameday_alert event; pick who gets a notification.
data_description.alert_notify: A notify service. Mobile-app notifications get a Watch button that tunes the TV.
data_description.local_teams: NFL Sunday afternoon games are regional: when several are on CBS or FOX at once, your station carries only one. Games for these teams are treated as local; the others are marked regional.
data_description.top_events: Featured games from leagues you don't follow (e.g. El Clásico when La Liga isn't picked), as chosen for ESPN's homepage scores bar. Marked "Featured" on the board.

lineup.title: Re-import channel lineup
lineup.description: Paste a fresh lineup from the snippet (needed if you move or change your YouTube TV plan).

error.bad_lineup: Couldn't find any channels in that text.
